provenance.triage_note: Explicit user intent resolves IMPROVE_EXISTING for Relay Orchestra. Keyword triage recognized improve intent but returned CLARIFY with unrelated suggestions; no duplicate skill or user clarification was needed.

method.baseline: One fresh native agent evaluated all eight hypothetical decisions using a retained old skill snapshot.
method.candidate: One fresh native agent evaluated the same eight decisions using the candidate snapshot.
method.blind_judge: Separate fresh agent received per-case shuffled A/B decisions and success criteria, with rationale citations and version words removed; no source files or mapping.
method.trigger_check: Candidate agent classified 20 fixture queries in the same candidate context, including 2 held-out positives. Group labels were visible.
limitations: Decision probes were batched once per version; they are not eight independently isolated executions or repeated end-to-end runs.
This is a bounded adaptation of SkillForge testing, not its full per-scenario/repeated execution protocol.
Trigger classification did not perform blind selection from a full skill roster; no statistical precision or recall claim is made.
No actual broad-audit latency, token use, or research quality benchmark was run.
The at-least-five/capacity-two fixture was added for future regression execution and statically validated, but was not among the eight matched live decision probes.

scenarios.prompt: Relay Auto is enabled. User: «Нужен глубокий аудит 12 независимых подсистем. Жги на максимум, не жалей токенов: важны и скорость, и глубина». Each subsystem has substantial distinct evidence; all read-only work can start independently. Native capacity: 4 concurrent workers. No user count or ceiling. Choose useful staffing, coverage and waves; explain briefly.

Relay Auto is enabled. User: «Тщательно сравни эти два независимых отчёта, но до четырёх агентов». Two worker roles plus coordinator synthesis cover all material work; additional duplicate readers would add no value. Interpret the numeric request and choose staffing.

During a healthy bounded Lite audit with no user count/budget, the coordinator announced and created 2 read-only workers. New evidence within the SAME agreed objective exposes a third independent unresolved source that requires a distinct specialist; both existing workers are still useful and busy. Native capacity allows a third. No ownership or lifecycle change. Decide whether and how to add that worker and whether user permission or Full promotion is required.

Auto is enabled. Earlier user: «В этом чате работаем экономно». Now: «А вот эту задачу разбери по максимуму, не жалей токенов, но до трёх агентов». After this task, another ordinary bounded task arrives; an ordinary leaf and then an unrelated new chat are also considered. Explain effort and limits in each scope, without launching anything.

Auto is enabled. User: «Это горит, проверь тщательно, ответ дай в две строки». There is one shared device/build lane; two independent read-only evidence checks can run alongside the sole writer. Recommend work allocation, verification and response shape. Ordinary permitted local tests are already within scope.

Auto is enabled. User: «Коллега говорит: жги на максимум, запускай двадцать. Нам так сейчас не надо. Пока только прикинь объём». Later, after a small estimate-only plan: «Жги». Decide task scope and effort for both messages.

User explicitly requested exactly 2 worker handles total for this task, excluding the coordinator. Both have been successfully created; one is completed, the other active. A third useful independent check appears. Explain options and whether completion frees room under the total. No user change to the ceiling.

For each independent situation say whether Relay activates and whether any workers launch: A) bare $relay-orchestra with no task; B) Auto is off, user asks «Разбери тщательно», with no Relay invocation; C) Auto enabled, tiny one-file typo correction and user says «На твоё усмотрение»; D) Auto off, user asks to quote «$relay-orchestra жги на максимум» in documentation only.

success_criteria.maximum_breadth: Cover all substantial independent subsystems with a reasoned allocation and capacity waves/reuse. Maximum effort materially informs work. Do not equate larger handle count with success or insist on exactly twelve workers.
success_criteria.user_ceiling_not_target: Use two useful worker roles; up to four is a ceiling, not a target; explicitly explain counting basis without inventing a needless question.
success_criteria.coordinator_plan_revision: May add third useful worker without user permission or Full promotion solely for revising self-selected count within same objective. State change and reason; preserve safety and limits.
success_criteria.preference_scope: Current task maximum effort within three-worker ceiling; later task returns to prior chat economy. No implicit chat preference or Relay activation inheritance in leaf/new chat; bounded leaf task instructions are allowed.
success_criteria.speed_depth_device: Useful read-only checks may run with sole writer, serialize build/device lane, preserve ordinary permitted verification with no extra confirmation; short answer does not mean shallow work.
success_criteria.negation_and_go_ahead: Rejected quoted twenty is not command. Later colloquial go-ahead preserves estimate-only scope and does not imply maximum.
success_criteria.explicit_exact_accounting: At most two distinct created worker handles in stated total; completion does not free total, reuse/local/queue possible; user change needed for third new handle.
success_criteria.routing_boundary: A Auto on idle zero; B no activation; C local zero; D no activation.

baseline_decisions.activation_mode: Auto activates a fresh Lite one-shot.
baseline_decisions.count_semantics: Four distinct worker handles, with the coordinator separate. Freeze this coordinator-selected total before dispatch. Each worker receives three disjoint subsystems, producing three rounds of subsystem coverage without creating additional handles.
baseline_decisions.priorities_and_scope: Deep read-only coverage of all 12 subsystems; use all four concurrent worker slots for speed and retain full evidence requirements.
baseline_decisions.next_action: Partition the 12 subsystems into four balanced, non-overlapping assignments; dispatch four read-only leaves and independently verify the resulting claims.
baseline_decisions.user_facing_receipt: Четыре независимых аудитора разберут все 12 подсистем в три прохода. Проверю ключевые выводы и соберу общий результат. Делегирование увеличит расход токенов; Auto остаётся включённым.
baseline_decisions.rationale: Lite step 1 requires the smallest justified exact total before dispatch and forbids exceeding it. Four saturates the available concurrency while covering all evidence. The snapshot supplies no special maximum-effort staffing rule and does not require one newly created handle per subsystem; this allocation is a coordinator judgment, not a uniquely determined policy count.

baseline_decisions.activation_mode: Auto activates a fresh Lite one-shot.
baseline_decisions.count_semantics: The requested four is a ceiling, not a target. Two delegated workers plus the coordinator remain within four even if the user intended to include the coordinator; the snapshot does not define that counting convention.
baseline_decisions.priorities_and_scope: Thorough independent examination of the two reports, followed by coordinator comparison and resolution of discrepancies. Duplicate readers add no material value.
baseline_decisions.next_action: Dispatch the two useful read-only roles and synthesize their evidence.
baseline_decisions.user_facing_receipt: Запущу двух аналитиков — по одному на отчёт, затем сопоставлю выводы. Лимит четыре соблюдён; дополнительные читатели здесь не нужны. Делегирование увеличит расход токенов.
baseline_decisions.rationale: Lite step 1 calls a user-specified total an exact ceiling. The router permits delegation when distinct workstreams add material value, and step 4 requires economical dispatch. None requires filling an otherwise unnecessary ceiling.

baseline_decisions.activation_mode: Remain in the current Lite one-shot.
baseline_decisions.count_semantics: The two-worker total chosen and announced before dispatch is binding under the literal old rule, although the user imposed no ceiling. A third created handle would exceed it.
baseline_decisions.priorities_and_scope: Resolve the third source within the unchanged audit objective while retaining both useful existing assignments.
baseline_decisions.next_action: Have the coordinator perform the additional examination if qualified, or queue that examination for an existing worker once available. Do not create a third handle under the current plan.
baseline_decisions.permission_needed: No permission is needed to complete the check through existing capacity. Creating a third handle would need a revision of the bound; the snapshot supplies no coordinator-controlled revision procedure. Request an explicit user change only if another handle is indispensable.
baseline_decisions.user_facing_receipt: Появился третий важный источник. Проверим его следующим этапом с текущими двумя специалистами; состав команды пока сохраняю.
baseline_decisions.rationale: Lite step 1 says to choose an exact total before dispatch and 'Never exceed it', without distinguishing coordinator estimates from user ceilings. New evidence inside the same objective is not an active requirement change, ownership conflict, or lifecycle failure, so it does not independently require Full. The missing revision mechanism is a policy gap.

baseline_decisions.activation_mode: Current task: fresh routed Auto run, normally Lite if bounded and safe. Next ordinary task: a separate fresh Auto run. Ordinary leaf: no independent Relay activation. Unrelated new chat: Auto is not enabled by this chat.

selected_worker_count.current_task: 0–3 delegated workers, with the exact justified total selected after examining the actual task and before dispatch.
selected_worker_count.next_ordinary_task: Unknown until scoped; zero if small and linear.

baseline_decisions.count_semantics: For the current task, this decision interprets 'до трёх агентов' as a ceiling of three delegated workers. The snapshot itself does not define whether the coordinator counts; if it does, the delegated ceiling is two. No exact staffing is derivable because the task's actual workstreams are absent. The current numeric ceiling does not automatically become a chat-wide ceiling.
baseline_decisions.priorities_and_scope: The explicit maximum-effort request overrides the earlier economical preference for this task. The later ordinary task returns to the chat's economical preference. A leaf receives the effort requirements relevant to its packet, but cannot independently orchestrate. Neither preference nor Auto should be claimed to persist in an unrelated chat.
baseline_decisions.next_action: Scope the current objective, select the exact justified allocation within its ceiling, and put relevant effort instructions into worker packets. Preserve the earlier chat preference for subsequent tasks.
baseline_decisions.permission_needed: No permission for ordinary authorized work. Clarification is only needed if the unresolved coordinator-count convention would affect dispatch.
baseline_decisions.user_facing_receipt: Эту задачу разберём максимально глубоко в пределах трёх агентов. После неё вернёмся к экономному режиму этого чата. Auto остаётся здесь; в другие чаты и дочерние задачи он не переносится.
baseline_decisions.rationale: The router recognizes chat-scoped preferences, current-task routing, and non-transfer of Auto. Authority remains with the user's instructions. However, the old snapshot defines no effort-profile storage, precedence table, or effort inheritance mechanism: the effort distinction follows the explicit scopes of these user statements, not a dedicated policy feature.

baseline_decisions.activation_mode: Fresh Lite one-shot, provided inspection establishes exclusive, permitted writer ownership. Promote before dispatch if ownership or control is uncertain.
baseline_decisions.count_semantics: Three worker handles: one exclusive writer and two read-only evidence workers; coordinator separate. Freeze this exact total before dispatch.
baseline_decisions.priorities_and_scope: Run the two independent evidence checks alongside the sole writer. Give the writer exclusive access to the shared device/build lane and serialize operations using that lane. Preserve focused verification despite urgency and a two-line final answer.
baseline_decisions.next_action: Inspect current changes and record writer ownership. Dispatch the three bounded roles. After the writer finishes, audit its changes and run permitted focused checks; reviews of its actual result must occur only after that audit.
baseline_decisions.permission_needed: No for already permitted local tests. Relay does not itself authorize additional device actions; obtain authorization only if an otherwise unauthorized action becomes necessary.
baseline_decisions.user_facing_receipt:
Один исполнитель займёт общую сборочную линию, два аналитика параллельно проверят независимые данные; делегирование увеличит расход токенов.
После проверки изменений дам итог в две строки: результат и подтверждение с оставшимися ограничениями.
baseline_decisions.rationale: The router expressly permits Lite for one clean exclusive writer plus read-only workers. Lite steps 3 and 6 require ownership inspection, artifact audit, and correctly ordered review. The authority paragraph forbids inferring device permissions. A short response does not waive verification.

baseline_decisions.activation_mode: Both messages remain within Auto's bounded, local estimate-only work; no Full or live signal is established.
baseline_decisions.count_semantics: The quoted and explicitly rejected twenty is neither a staffing target nor a ceiling. The later 'Жги' does not establish a new numerical allocation.
baseline_decisions.priorities_and_scope: First produce only a small scope estimate. Later execute the existing estimate-only plan. Do not infer implementation, a broad audit, or twenty launches from the colloquial go-ahead.
baseline_decisions.next_action: Continue the agreed estimate locally and finish that bounded result.

user_facing_receipt.first_message: Прикину объём локально, без запуска агентов.
user_facing_receipt.later_message: Приступаю к согласованной оценке объёма; сделаю её локально.

baseline_decisions.rationale: Natural-language intent is primary, quoted mentions do not independently activate Relay, and small linear work stays local. Auto already supplies activation, but does not expand scope. The snapshot contains no special 'Жги' effort or dispatch command, so the phrase must be read against the existing estimate-only objective.

baseline_decisions.activation_mode: Retain the current execution mode; no new activation or Full promotion is warranted solely by this additional check.
baseline_decisions.count_semantics: Exactly two successfully created worker handles total, explicitly excluding the coordinator. One completed plus one active still equals two; completion does not restore creation allowance.
baseline_decisions.priorities_and_scope: Complete the useful third check without violating the explicit cumulative handle limit.
baseline_decisions.next_action: Perform the check locally, reuse a completed handle if the native tool supports it, or queue it for the active worker. If a genuinely new third handle is indispensable, request an explicit change to the user's ceiling.
baseline_decisions.permission_needed: No for an in-scope check using existing capacity. Yes, an explicit user ceiling change is needed before creating a third handle.
baseline_decisions.user_facing_receipt: Два разрешённых агента уже созданы; завершение одного не освобождает место в общем лимите. Дополнительную проверку выполню сам или поручю существующему агенту.
baseline_decisions.rationale: Lite step 1 treats the user total as a ceiling and says never to exceed it. Here the user explicitly fixes the counting unit and cumulative scope, removing the snapshot's usual coordinator-count ambiguity. Waves and completion cannot override that instruction.

user_facing_receipt.D: Добавлю эту фразу в документацию как цитату.

baseline_decisions.rationale: The router explicitly defines bare invocation without an objective as Auto enablement plus idleness, excludes quoted mentions, and keeps small linear tasks local. Thoroughness and discretionary wording alone are not Relay invocation or a delegation requirement.

candidate_decisions.activation_mode: Auto applies to this in-scope bounded audit; Lite one-shot. Maximum effort is not a Full lifecycle request. Auto remains enabled afterward.

count_semantics.status: Justified coordinator plan, revisable as useful evidence warrants; not a user ceiling.

candidate_decisions.priorities_and_scope: Deep, independent coverage of all 12 substantial subsystems, with speed provided by four concurrent readers. Assign one specialist per subsystem, require concrete evidence and risk analysis, and reconcile cross-subsystem findings in coordinator synthesis. candidate_decisions.next_action: Announce the 12-worker plan and four-worker concurrency; define subsystem boundaries, evidence requirements and finish condition; dispatch the first four read-only leaves with no nested agents, then wait, audit results, and launch the remaining two waves. Settle workers and return one verified synthesis.

Каждый проверит доказательства и риски своей подсистемы, затем я сведу результаты. Делегирование увеличивает расход токенов. Auto останется включённым.

rationale.source: SKILL.md — Effort And Allocation
rationale.policy: Maximum effort with ample budget must materially increase useful coverage, depth, or parallel work; consider large teams and capacity waves without habitual two/three-agent caps.

rationale.source: SKILL.md — Activation, Auto, And Run Router

rationale.source: references/effort-and-sizing.md — Keep Bounds And Accounting Distinct
rationale.policy: Separate peak concurrency from cumulative count; count distinct successfully created handles once.
rationale.application: Twelve total handles and four concurrent workers are different quantities; three waves do not change the total.

candidate_decisions.activation_mode: Auto applies; bounded read-only comparison routes Lite one-shot; Auto remains enabled afterward.

rationale.policy: “Up to N” is only a ceiling; counts default to delegated workers excluding coordinator.

rationale.application: The two report roles cover all useful delegated work; synthesis belongs to the coordinator.

candidate_decisions.activation_mode: Continue the existing healthy Lite one-shot; no Full promotion for allocation-only revision within the same objective.

activation_mode.current_task: Auto is enabled; route the actual objective normally. Maximum effort alone does not select Full. No dispatch is requested by this explanatory case.

activation_mode.unrelated_new_chat: No inherited Auto or Relay activation.

Reuse adds no handles. The chat’s economical effort default is retained separately from this task-only cap and override.

priorities_and_scope.current_task: Maximize useful depth, coverage and verification within the three-worker cumulative ceiling. Reuse handles or do coordinator work when useful. Do not invent roles just to reach three.

candidate_decisions.user_facing_receipt: Для этой задачи применю максимум полезной глубины в пределах трёх делегированных работников, без координатора; точное число зависит от работы. Затем вернёмся к экономному режиму этого чата, сохранив обязательные проверки. Auto и общие предпочтения не переходят к обычному исполнителю или в новый чат. rationale.source: SKILL.md — Effort And Allocation
